prompt: Company profile: Furniture manufacturer in Hickory, North Carolina; 75 employees. Situation: The company is installing a new enclosed spray-finishing booth for solvent-borne lacquers and sealers; projected coating usage implies roughly 8 tons per year of VOC emissions potential. The change adds spray operations, flammable liquid storage, spent solvent and lacquer waste, and used booth filters. Ask: Identify the compliance obligations this situation creates or affects for the compliance-obligations register. For each obligation: state the requirement, its source, its applicability to this company, the ISO clause it maps to (ISO 14001 6.1.3 / ISO 45001 6.1.3), and how and when compliance should be evaluated (9.1.2).
response:
**COMPLIANCE OBLIGATIONS REGISTER**  
*Furniture Manufacturer – Hickory, NC (75 Employees) – New Spray-Finishing Booth Installation*

---

### **1. Air Quality Operating Permit (Title V Minor)**
**Requirement:** Obtain a Title V Minor operating permit before commencing operations; comply with emission limits, recordkeeping (monthly coating usage logs), and reporting conditions.  
**Regulatory Source:** NCAC 2D .0501 (North Carolina Air Quality Regulations); 40 CFR 70 (Federal Title V Program).  
**Applicability:** Facility will emit ~8 tons/year (16,000 lbs) of VOCs, exceeding the 5-ton/year threshold for Title V Minor sources in NC.  
**ISO 14001 Clause:** 6.1.3 (Legal & Other Requirements – Environmental)  
**ISO 45001 Clause:** Not applicable (environmental-only)  
**Evaluation (9.1.2):** Review permit conditions quarterly; conduct annual compliance audit; verify monthly VOC calculations against permit limits; reapply/renew per NC DEQ schedule (typically every 5 years).

---

### **2. NESHAP for Wood Furniture Manufacturing (40 CFR 63 Subpart JJ)**
**Requirement:** Comply with GACT standards for area sources: use HVLP or equivalent spray guns; maintain spray booth overspray filters; implement work practice standards; submit initial notification and annual compliance certifications.  
**Regulatory Source:** 40 CFR 63 Subpart JJ (National Emission Standards for Hazardous Air Pollutants).  
**Applicability:** Applies to all wood furniture manufacturing facilities using coatings with HAPs, regardless of emission levels (area source status).  
**ISO 14001 Clause:** 6.1.3  
**ISO 45001 Clause:** Not applicable  
**Evaluation (9.1.2):** Annual self-certification of compliance; review coating formulations annually for HAP content; inspect spray equipment and filters monthly; maintain records of notifications and certifications.

---

### **3. EPCRA Section 313 – Toxic Release Inventory (TRI) Reporting**
**Requirement:** Annually report VOC emissions (and other toxic chemicals) to EPA and NC DEQ if usage exceeds thresholds. Report due July 1 each year.  
**Regulatory Source:** 40 CFR 372 (EPCRA); 15A NCAC 2D .0200.  
**Applicability:** 8 tons VOC = 16,000 lbs/year, exceeding the 10,000 lbs/year "otherwise used" threshold for TRI-listed chemicals (e.g., toluene, xylene in lacquers).  
**ISO 14001 Clause:** 6.1.3  
**ISO 45001 Clause:** Not applicable  
**Evaluation (9.1.2):** Annual evaluation during TRI reporting cycle; calculate emissions by March 1; review chemical inventories quarterly; verify threshold calculations after any coating formula change.

---

### **4. EPCRA Section 311/312 – Tier II Hazardous Chemical Inventory**
**Requirement:** Submit annual Tier II report by March 1 for hazardous chemicals stored above threshold quantities (e.g., 10,000 lbs aggregate for flammable liquids).  
**Regulatory Source:** 40 CFR 370; NC General Statute §95-196.  
**Applicability:** Flammable lacquers, thinners, and solvents stored likely exceed Tier II thresholds for a 75-employee operation.  
**ISO 14001 Clause:** 6.1.3 (spill/release prevention)  
**ISO 45001 Clause:** 6.1.3 (emergency planning)  
**Evaluation (9.1.2):** Annual reporting by March 1; conduct quarterly inventory audits; update report within 30 days of significant chemical quantity change or new chemical introduction.

---

### **5. Hazardous Waste Management (RCRA/NC Rules)**
**Requirement:** Determine generator status; obtain EPA ID number if LQG; comply with accumulation time limits (90-day for LQG, 180-day for SQG), labeling (40 CFR 262), manifesting, and biennial reporting.  
**Regulatory Source:** 40 CFR 262; 15A NCAC 13A (NC Hazardous Waste Management Rules).  
**Applicability:** Spent solvents (F003/F005) and lacquer waste are hazardous waste. A 75-employee spray booth operation likely generates >100 kg/month, classifying as SQG or LQG.  
**ISO 14001 Clause:** 6.1.3  
**ISO 45001 Clause:** 6.1.3 (worker exposure during handling)  
**Evaluation (9.1.2):** Monthly waste generation tracking to maintain generator status; annual waste audits; review manifests quarterly; inspect accumulation areas weekly; verify biennial report accuracy (due March 1 of even years).

---

### **6. Flammable Liquid Storage (OSHA & NC Fire Code)**
**Requirement:** Store flammable liquids in approved containers/cabinets (≤60 gal/cabinet); limit storage room quantities; ensure electrical equipment is rated for Class I, Division 1/Division 2 areas; provide spill containment.  
**Regulatory Source:** 29 CFR 1910.106; 2018 NC Fire Code (adopting IFC Chapters 15 & 57).  
**Applicability:** Storage of solvent-borne lacquers and thinners triggers flammable liquid rules.  
**ISO 14001 Clause:** 6.1.3 (spill prevention)  
**ISO 45001 Clause:** 6.1.3 (fire/explosion hazard)  
**Evaluation (9.1.2):** Monthly inspections of storage areas; annual third-party fire code compliance audit; verify cabinet ratings and inventory limits quarterly; conduct post-incident reviews after any spill or near-miss.

---

### **7. Spray Finishing Operations (OSHA 1910.107)**
**Requirement:** Booth must meet UL or NFPA 33 construction standards; maintain airflow ≥100 fpm; use approved exhaust filters; prohibit ignition sources; post "No Smoking" signs; conduct periodic inspections.  
**Regulatory Source:** 29 CFR 1910.107 (Spray Finishing Using Flammable or Combustible Materials).  
**Applicability:** Directly applies to new enclosed spray-finishing booth operations.  
**ISO 14001 Clause:** Not applicable (safety-only)  
**ISO 45001 Clause:** 6.1.3  
**Evaluation (9.1.2):** Weekly booth airflow velocity checks; monthly filter pressure drop inspections; annual booth certification by qualified technician; review after any ventilation modification or fire incident.

---

### **8. Industrial Stormwater Permit (NPDES)**
**Requirement:** Obtain coverage under NCG010000 (Industrial Stormwater General Permit); develop Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plan (SWPPP); conduct quarterly stormwater sampling; perform annual comprehensive site inspections.  
**Regulatory Source:** 15A NCAC 2H .0126; NPDES General Permit NCG010000.  
**Applicability:** Furniture manufacturing (SIC 25) is a regulated industrial sector; new outdoor storage of solvents/materials may expose stormwater to pollutants.  
**ISO 14001 Clause:** 6.1.3  
**ISO 45001 Clause:** Not applicable  
**Evaluation (9.1.2):** Quarterly benchmark monitoring; annual SWPPP review; conduct inspections after storms >0.1 inches; annual permit compliance certification.

---

### **9. Spill Prevention, Control & Countermeasure (SPCC)**
**Requirement:** Develop and implement SPCC Plan if total aboveground storage capacity ≥1,320 gallons; include tank integrity testing, secondary containment, and employee training.  
**Regulatory Source:** 40 CFR 112.  
**Applicability:** Applicable if aggregate flammable liquid storage (including totes, drums, tanks) meets threshold.  
**ISO 14001 Clause:** 6.1.3  
**ISO 45001 Clause:** 6.1.3 (emergency response)  
**Evaluation (9.1.2):** Annual plan review and certification; monthly storage tank/container inspections; conduct drills semi-annually; update plan within 6 months of any material change.

---

### **10. OSHA Hazard Communication (HAZCOM)**
**Requirement:** Maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS) for all lacquers/solvents; ensure containers are labeled; provide employee training on chemical hazards; update written program.  
**Regulatory Source:** 29 CFR 1910.1200.  
**Applicability:** All employers with hazardous chemicals. New coatings trigger update requirements.  
**ISO 14001 Clause:** 6.1.3 (chemical spill potential)  
**ISO 45001 Clause:** 6.1.3  
**Evaluation (9.1.2):** Annual program review; verify SDS availability quarterly; conduct training for new hires and annually for all employees; review after introducing new coating product.

---

### **11. Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Assessment**
**Requirement:** Assess need for respiratory protection (organic vapor cartridges), eye/face protection, and chemical-resistant gloves; provide PPE at no cost; conduct fit-testing and training if respirators required.  
**Regulatory Source:** 29 CFR 1910.132; 29 CFR 1910.134.  
**Applicability:** Spray operations generate inhalation and dermal exposure hazards.  
**ISO 14001 Clause:** Not applicable  
**ISO 45001 Clause:** 6.1.3  
**Evaluation (9.1.2):** Annual hazard assessment; quarterly PPE effectiveness reviews; fit testing annually (or when facial changes occur); inspect respirators monthly.

---

### **12. Fire Marshal Permit & Inspection (Local)**
**Requirement:** Obtain operational permit from Hickory Fire Department for spray booth and flammable liquid storage; comply with pre-occupancy inspection; maintain clearances and fire protection equipment.  
**Regulatory Source:** 2018 NC Fire Code §105.6.32; Hickory Fire Marshal Local Ordinance.  
**Applicability:** Local fire code requires permits for hazardous operations.  
**ISO 14001 Clause:** 6.1.3 (fire-related environmental release)  
**ISO 45001 Clause:** 6.1.3  
**Evaluation (9.1.2):** Annual fire marshal inspection; monthly internal fire safety audits; immediate re-inspection after any fire incident or booth modification.

---

### **13. Emergency Action & Fire Prevention Plan**
**Requirement:** Develop written Emergency Action Plan (EAP) and Fire Prevention Plan (FPP) addressing spray booth emergencies; train employees on evacuation routes and alarm systems; maintain fire extinguishers (Class B) within 30 feet.  
**Regulatory Source:** 29 CFR 1910.38; 29 CFR 1910.39; 29 CFR 1910.157.  
**Applicability:** Required for facilities with flammable liquid spray operations.  
**ISO 14001 Clause:** 6.1.3 (emergency preparedness for environmental releases)  
**ISO 45001 Clause:** 6.1.3  
**Evaluation (9.1.2):** Annual plan review and drill; quarterly fire extinguisher inspections; evaluate after any emergency event or organizational change.

---

**Note:** This register should be maintained as a living document. The company must verify actual storage capacities, waste generation rates, and coating formulations to confirm exact applicability. Contact **NC DEQ – Asheville Regional Office** (air, waste), **Hickory Fire Department** (fire code), and **OSHA Consultation Service** for definitive determinations.
